comparison.objective: Take a tabletop curling shot while intercepting a runaway stone.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate two arms dynamically: slide one stone, intercept another, then withdraw.
comparison.success_condition: All four stones remain on the board after the shot and rescue; unauthorized contact fails.
comparison.reason: Dynamic bimanual interception and sliding control do not test adjustable hardware commissioning or small-tool reacquisition.
